I noticed that on both my Nexus 6 and Nexus 9, the Newsstand app is missing animations. Up until Newsstand 3.3 it had the icons flowing around the screen (see below), starting with 3.3.1 all the way up to the latest 3.4.2 these animations are completely gone.

Here is a quick video of what each version looks like on my Nexus 9 (video with no sound, promise): https://youtu.be/lkgdOKQOI28

Using my friends devices I tested to see if this was the case with all devices but to my surprise everything else I tested it on still had the animations on versions 3.3.1+. Can anyone else with a Nexus 6 or 9 confirm if they're also experiencing this?

EDIT: I figured the issue out it has to do with having any accessibility option enabled. It's apparently a bug in Lollipop that might also have a side effect of lagging other parts of your device. If you are having this issue try disabling any accessibility option you might have enabled.
